Engineering and Medical Entrance Exam Seat Allotments Announced

Seat allotment results for the AIIMS INI CET 2026 second round and the TGECET final phase have been released. The TGECET saw 70.2% of engineering seats filled, with Computer Science and AI courses being popular choices, while pharmacy seats lagged. The AIIMS INI CET results include cut-off ranks for the last phase of admissions.
